title: Loop 1604 at Dove Canyon

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located at the northwest corner of Loop 1604 and Dove Canyon on the west side of San Antonio. It is just south of Loop 1604 and Potranco and the new Dove Crossing retail center, Costco and WalMart.

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: The Federal Emergency Management Agency maps appear to indicate that there is some Floodplain present on the northern end of the property.

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: The property generally slopes and drains from South to North.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: 2024 Texas Department of Transportation maps indicate 36,705 vehicles per day on Loop 1604, north of the property and 53,870 vehicles per day on Loop 1604, south of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: Significant commercial development is just north of the property including Costco, Dove Crossing Retail Center, and Walmart.

rows.label: Potential Uses
rows.text: This property would suit a variety of commercial uses including retail, multifamily and healthcare.

comments: Exceptional growth continues on the west side of the San Antonio metro area, which is driving the need for retail, multifamily, and other commercial uses.
